purpose: Positive authority controls for moving ProofResume from local product work to externally visible business activity, revenue generation, and customer learning without inventing evidence or asking for routine permission.
operatingRule: Agents may act without action-time confirmation only inside controls whose status is enabled and whose required evidence is present. If a control is setup_needed or blocked, agents prepare everything up to the boundary and ask only for the missing item named by that control.

moneyGoal.target: Generate revenue from evidence-backed resume reviews.
moneyGoal.nextRevenueUnlock: Enable public deploy, production lead capture, and payment-intent capture with explicit limits.

humanStopRequiredFor: spending above daily or monthly limit
collecting fields outside the approved customer-data schema
changing DNS ownership or transferring domains
submitting job applications without explicit candidate consent
globalLimits.autonomyPrinciple: Agents should act toward revenue when inside enabled controls, prefer free-tier proof-of-concept paths, log evidence for every external action, and stop only at explicit control boundaries.

controls.label: Public deploy
controls.businessPurpose: Make the website reachable by prospects and search/social traffic.
agentCanDoWhenEnabled: select and configure a free-tier static hosting path when no secrets or paid plan are required
deploy the approved static site
run post-deploy route checks
record production health evidence

controls.label: Production lead capture
controls.businessPurpose: Collect real prospect interest and convert it into scheduled free audits or paid review intent.
agentCanDoWhenEnabled: use free-tier managed forms/databases or repository-backed JSONL when appropriate
store allowed lead fields
route leads into the admin dashboard
score lead source and target role fit
prepare outreach follow-up drafts
requiredEvidenceToEnable: approved storage destination or free-tier/local fallback

disallowedFields: full resume text in production lead form

askUserOnlyFor: external database or form service access

controls.label: Outbound outreach
controls.businessPurpose: Reach qualified prospects and book evidence-backed resume audits.
agentCanDoNow: build targeting rules without contact details
agentCanDoWhenEnabled: source prospects under recipient source policy
send messages within daily limits
record real sent facts
route replies into scheduling or objection handling
requiredEvidenceToEnable: authorized sending account or approved platform connector

channels: approved communities where self-promotion is permitted

stopConditions: message contains unsupported outcome or demand claim

controls.label: Payment collection
controls.businessPurpose: Turn validated resume-review interest into actual revenue.
agentCanDoWhenEnabled: recommend and configure free setup payment-link providers when connector/access exists
publish approved payment links
record payment intent and conversion evidence
run approved price tests within limit
requiredEvidenceToEnable: payment provider or payment-link access, or documented blocker if access is unavailable

controls.label: Analytics
controls.businessPurpose: Learn which pages, offers, and traffic sources produce revenue intent.
agentCanDoWhenEnabled: configure privacy-safe free-tier analytics when no sensitive resume text is sent
instrument approved events
report funnel metrics in admin
run page-copy experiments

controls.label: Customer resume data
controls.businessPurpose: Process real customer resumes safely outside local-only prototype mode.
agentCanDoWhenEnabled: accept real resume uploads or paste data through the approved secure path
apply retention and deletion policy
surface processing state in admin
requiredEvidenceToEnable: secure storage path or local-first customer-controlled processing path

controls.label: Job sourcing and scraping
controls.businessPurpose: Find target jobs, learn market demand, and support job-search workflows without relying only on manual paste.
agentCanDoNow: record source, terms-risk notes, and freshness
agentCanDoWhenEnabled: collect public job posting metadata
normalize leads into the local tracker
monitor target companies and public boards
avoid authentication bypass, CAPTCHAs, rate-limit abuse, and sources that forbid scraping
askUserOnlyFor: approval to use sources with unclear or restrictive terms
stopConditions: personal data not needed for job matching appears in output

controls.label: Auto-apply and application submission
controls.businessPurpose: Support job seekers with controlled application workflows when they explicitly authorize submission.
agentCanDoNow: log every field that would be submitted
agentCanDoWhenEnabled: fill and submit applications only after explicit candidate consent for the target job
attach only approved materials
record submitted facts and confirmation
stop on novel questions, EEO/disability/veteran questions, salary negotiation, legal attestations, or anything requiring personal judgment

controls.label: External services and connectors
controls.businessPurpose: Use best-in-class commodity services instead of rebuilding auth, hosting, payments, email, analytics, storage, scheduling, or CRM.
agentCanDoNow: configure services that require no payment and no unavailable secret
write setup requests only for missing credentials/connectors
agentCanDoWhenEnabled: activate free-tier services within the approved provider pattern
spend within daily/monthly limit when the case is documented
log provider, purpose, cost, and rollback path
stopConditions: provider would receive data outside approved schema
